newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barges rates for bids, offers thin on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barges rates for bids, offers thin on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were thinly bid and offered on St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded Thursday, just like Wednesday.
- Two barges, next week, Illinois River, bid 200 percent of tariff, no offer.
- Two barges, week of Oct 20, Mid-Mississippi, bid 210 percent, no offer.
- Four barges, two each week of Oct 20, 27, Illinois River, bid 210 percent, offered 220 percent.
